groups.finding: Grounded implementation contradicts a hover-specific test
groups.observation: FoxMatron constructs no flying MoveControl, creates GroundPathNavigation, and explicitly restores noGravity=false on NBT load. The old test requires noGravity=true and a stable half-block hover. No conclusion here about whether design should be grounded or hovering; do not change current entity design just to satisfy a stale test.

groups.finding: Simultaneous tests overwrite the shared mobGriefing gamerule
groups.observation: Both methods belong to rage_corpse and start together in one batch. One schedules global mobGriefing=false at tick4 and verifies protected floor at tick39; the destructive case schedules true at tick4 and restores at tick42. Test positions do not isolate a world gamerule. Native crater code already calls ForgeEventFactory.getMobGriefingEvent; deleting that guard or weakening the floor assertion is unjustified.

groups.finding: Nearby same-type fixtures can veto encounter spawn tests
groups.observation: bow_ritual_test is16x14x16. Native batch placement advances width+5 and row depth+6, hence adjacent fixture origins are21 or22blocks apart. Encounter methods veto any live same-type entity inside a32block-inflated box. Several tests in each same-name batch create that same type concurrently. This is an explicit plausible interference path; floor, difficulty, border, fluid, collision and ticking preconditions still require instrumentation before assigning each exact failure.

groups.finding: Trial damage check occurs during native player spawn immunity
groups.observation: Fixture creates a normal new ServerPlayer and uses generic1damage at test tick20 without asserting hurt accepted or health loss. Native1.20.1ServerPlayer starts with60ticks spawnInvulnerableTime and rejects non-bypass damage while positive. Production cancellation listens to positive LivingDamageEvent; if hurt is rejected, absence of cancellation does not establish a trial bug. Other artifact failures occurring after80ticks are not explained by this finding.
